name: Kaikielius
description: Kaikielius was a planet in the Kaikielius system of the Core Worlds. Rin Praji, a noble of House Praji, owned an estate on Kaikielius. After winning a holocron that once belonged to Cin Drallig at an auction on Denon, Praji moved it to Kaikielius aboard a luxury yacht.
lead_paragraphs: Kaikielius was a planet in the Kaikielius system of the Core Worlds. Rin Praji, a noble of House Praji, owned an estate on Kaikielius. After winning a holocron that once belonged to Cin Drallig at an auction on Denon, Praji moved it to Kaikielius aboard a luxury yacht.
